required.note: derived: gcp is the only provider row with sync_status stale and data_through before 2026-08-31; the forms are subject-anchored sentences, not a seed literal
required.rationale: subject-anchored so a reading that names aws or azure as the laggard earns nothing

required.asked_by: what is the last date it has data
required.note: gcp data_through 2026-08-22; the date occurs on no other row
required.rationale: the date is unique to the gcp row, so it binds to the lagging provider without naming it

required.asked_by: Do the other providers have data for every day of the month?
required.rationale: the only provider rows carrying the 31st are aws and azure
